en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a grand Romanesque cathedral with four towers at the far end of a terraced fountain garden and promenade. Many small figures walk or sit along the paths in front of the church. The front caption reads "Pécs" on the left and "Székesegyház" on the right. The reverse side has handwritten Hungarian text, address lines, a circular postmark mentioning "Pécs," and a Budapest printer's mark.
